title: Blue Catgirl Pose Triptych
description: A three-panel composition against a solid bright pink background showing the same blue-haired female character with cat ears and a tail. Left panel: dynamic standing action pose with claws extended. Middle panel: mid-air falling pose with limbs outstretched. Right panel: lying on her side in a relaxed pose.
